releases.description:
# Changelog

## 1.0.0

- Add an adjustable 40–400 ms stacked-tab transition duration.
- Preserve the sliding animation with an ease-out curve.
- Limit the override to horizontal scrolling in stacked tab groups.
- Restore native scrolling when the plugin is disabled.
